name: Planoly
description: Planoly is a social media planning and scheduling platform. You link your social accounts to Planoly once, and this MCP then works across all of them from that single account: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Threads, and X. Because those platform connections live in Planoly, the connector never handles your social logins.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Planoly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Planoly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.planoly.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Planoly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planoly lists 24 MCP tools, including confirm_asset_upload, create_asset_from_url, create_media_library_folder, create_media_library_item, create_post, create_post_report_share_link, delete_media_library_item, delete_post_group, get_instagram_account_posts, get_instagram_analytics, get_media_preview, and list_channels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Planoly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Planoly in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Planoly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Planoly is developed by Planoly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
